name: dev-loop
description: Six-step dev workflow orchestrator that routes intent through released recipes and exact released slot contracts, preserves evidence across stages, and fails closed when required inputs or release evidence are missing.
descriptionZh: 六步研发闭环编排器：将意图路由到已发布 recipe，再按精确版本调用已发布 slot contract；跨阶段保留输入与证据，缺少必要输入或发布证据时返回 needs-input 或 blocked。
